notes: The 'two programs missing' pipeline: burdf/burd_label2f format catalog, PROC FREQ crosstabs, PROC SUMMARY with CLASS+PRELOADFMT+COMPLETETYPES, PROC SQL aggregation, and a DATA step building the two-letter burden-combination code (LL/LC/LP/...) via CATX concatenation plus a 10-way cascading IF/ELSE IF, finishing with PROC SGPLOT HBAR stat=sum. AN.coenrollim_us mocked with a 24-row inline DATALINES dataset (AN_coenrollim_us, built directly in script.sas so the bundle is self-contained -- no external libname needed) covering all six two-program-missing benefit_ct groups (11/101/110/1001/1010/1100) with two of the four burden columns populated per row, matching the shape the script reads. Logic, PROC options, and format definitions are unmodified from the author's script.
